source_text: 在中国文化中，黄颜色是一种很重要的颜色，因为它具有独特的象征意义。在封建(feudal)社会中，它象征统 治者的权力和权威。那时，黄色是专为皇帝使用的颜色，皇家宫殿全部漆成黄色，皇袍总是黄色的， 而普 通老百姓是禁止穿黄色衣服的。在中国，黄色也是收获的象征。秋天庄稼成熟时，田野变得一片金黄。 人 们兴高采烈，庆祝丰收。
reference_translation: In Chinese culture, yellow is a very important color because it has unique symbolic meanings. In the feudal society, it symbolized the power and authority of the rulers. At that time, yellow was the color exclusively for the emperor. All the royal palaces were painted yellow, and the imperial robes were always yellow. Ordinary people were prohibited from wearing yellow clothes. In China, yellow is also a symbol of harvest. When the crops mature in autumn, the fields turn golden yellow. People are in high spirits and celebrate the harvest.
